name: tower
description: Tower: tickets, projects and free sessions with a flightdeck (agents, timeline, usage, routing), for any git repository (GitHub issues or Linear tickets), new projects and free sessions. /tower turns any session into a free session; /tower install adds the tower launcher (tmux).

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Colours of the rail and the deck: ghostty takes your Ghostty colours (the claude ones when none were found), claude uses the Claude palette, terminal follows your Claude Code theme, matrix is green on black. TOWER_THEME or CCtower --theme wins, and only a theme set at launch also recolours the rail's own frame and tmux.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Which model does which kind of work: enforce reroutes and refuses spawns by the rules, observe only records what it would do, off does neither.
